# capellactl → cbctl test port table

Every capellactl test (all 151 `tests/**/test_*.py` files, 878 test functions at `6389d5a`) is
accounted for here: covered by a named Go test, partial, missing, or n/a with a reason.

- **Source list:** `internal/cli/testdata/capellactl-tests.txt`, generated from the checkout by
  `go run ./cmd/cbdev docs port-list --source ../capellactl`.
- **Port map:** `internal/cli/testdata/port-map.tsv`, one hand-written row per test: status, the Go
  test(s) that cover it (`TestName` or `TestName/subtest`) and the evidence or the reason.
- **Check:** `make port-table`. It fails when a test has no row, a row matches no test, a cited Go test
  does not exist (so deleting a cited test fails the check), an n/a row has no reason, the done share
  (covered + n/a) drops below the floor in the `Makefile`, or the counts below are out of date
  (`make port-footer` regenerates them).

A test with no row counts as covered only when every `@pytest.mark.story` tag it carries names a Go
test (`…_CAPxxx_ACn_…`); the "by AC tag" column counts those.

Statuses:

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| covered | A Go test asserts the same observable behaviour (exit code, output, API effect, file) |
| partial | Some assertions are mirrored, or only at a lower level than the Python test |
| missing | No Go test asserts it; the row says whether cbctl implements the behaviour |
| n/a | Python-only or deliberately not ported; the row gives the reason |

The counts below are generated; do not edit them.
